title: Concept: OpenSearch Dashboards console is reachable without authentication
description: Dashboards is a browser-side client for the cluster API, and its dev tools console forwards raw requests. A reachable shell without a login therefore means the cluster API behind it is reachable with the same lack of authentication, including index deletion.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller queries every index, reads documents the application stores, and can delete indices through the dev tools console.
